Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 94. Category: form. No-Ego.

Power-Up
You master a state of control within your ki that while it
may not enhance your strength, refines all control of
your capabilities:
You reduce the ki spent on techniques equal to your
Ki-Rank
You cannot gain the Berserk Conditions
Any technique that has “Charge”, you may reduce
the casting time by 1 step
At the end of your turn, you lose 2 Stamina
